command_tool_class: ledger correction: an earlier row's output artifact was superseded
detail: SW-279 review round 1. The answerability finalizer was re-run after three changes, and the ledger it writes changed with them, so sequences 15, 16 and 17 all name a digest (5ac94b3fc4961cd90dacfea05973f266a190ce267d46f617f6ad1e51e60...) that no longer resolves; the authoritative digest is the one on this row and on the finalizer's own re-run row. The three changes: (1) the unresolved -> not_answerable conversion was removed because Section 4 forbids treating an unresolved candidate as a reject and Section 8 lists reinterpreting one among the forbidden acts; (2) annotator identity is now taken from the batch plan and each actor's own attestation instead of being inferred from judgements, which corrected 23 rejected rows that had recorded a filename where an actor name belongs and made the same-actor independence guard able to fire on them; (3) rejection notes now have their file:line citations resolved mechanically against the pinned tree. Issue 1780, the row the removed conversion had been applied to, was re-annotated first-person by a fresh annotator (A6) and independently reviewed by a fresh reviewer (R6), both of which had not seen the row; both the original unresolved verdict and the original reviewer's D3 finding are retained on the ledger row. The terminal-state counts did not move: 71 accept, 23 reject, 0 unresolved, 41 answerable dev and 64 answerable holdout, and cobra-v2.json rebuilt byte-identically.
